name: bizdays-toolkit
description: Holidays, business-day calendar and day-by-day schedules (e.g. store hours) with time zone support. Japanese holidays verified against the Cabinet Office data; UK bank holidays (England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland) verified against GOV.UK and The Gazette; French public holidays (metropole, Alsace-Moselle) verified against data.gouv.fr; Singapore public holidays verified against data.gov.sg. / 祝日と営業日のカレンダー（タイムゾーン対応・日本の祝日は内閣府、英国の bank holidays は GOV.UK と The Gazette、フランスの祝日は data.gouv.fr、シンガポールの祝日は data.gov.sg のデータで全日照合）

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --removeComments && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.check: node scripts/check-toolchain.ts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:tz && pnpm build && pnpm test:compat && node scripts/check-readme-examples.ts && node scripts/check-consumer-types.ts && pnpm fmt:check && node scripts/check-package.ts && node scripts/check-size.ts && node scripts/check-names.ts && node scripts/api-report.ts
